worldFact.fact: On the third Saturday of February, as many as 10,000 men wearing only white loincloths and socks cram into Okayama's Saidai-ji temple. At 10pm a pair of sacred sticks is thrown into the crush, and whoever wrestles one free becomes a fuku-otoko, a 'lucky man', in a ritual traced back to 1510.
